"""JSON batch entry point of the eMicro CPU control plane.

Reads one UTF-8 JSON request from standard input and writes one JSON response
to standard output.  Whole-request envelope failures are rejected before any
job is replayed; structurally invalid jobs are rejected without replay.
"""

import json
import math
import os
import re
import select
import sys

_HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
if _HERE not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, _HERE)

from syntax import parse_policy, PolicyError
from ebpf.helper import Agent

U32 = 4294967295
INPUT_CAP = 24 * 1024 * 1024
MAX_JOBS = 4
MAX_EVENTS = 200000
MAX_STAGES = 16
POLICY_CAP = 8 * 1024 * 1024
ATOM_CAP = 32768
PATH_CAP = 65536
NESTING_CAP = 64

NAME = re.compile(r'[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]{0,23}\Z')
LIMIT_MAX = {'images': 16, 'cells': 262144, 'units': 1024, 'contexts': 32768,
             'connections': 4096, 'packets': 32768, 'files': 8192}

K_POS, K_UNIT, K_PAIR, K_NAME, K_TEXT, K_WIRE = range(6)
SCHEMA = {
    'stage': {'epoch': K_POS, 'policy': K_TEXT},
    'commit': {'epoch': K_POS},
    'retire': {'epoch': K_POS},
    'spawn': {'unit': K_UNIT, 'service': K_NAME},
    'clone': {'parent': K_UNIT, 'child': K_UNIT},
    'exit': {'unit': K_UNIT},
    'begin': {'unit': K_UNIT, 'rid': K_POS},
    'finish': {'unit': K_UNIT, 'rid': K_POS},
    'open': {'connection': K_PAIR},
    'close': {'connection': K_PAIR},
    'send': {'unit': K_UNIT, 'rid': K_POS, 'connection': K_PAIR,
             'stream': K_POS, 'destination': K_NAME},
    'recv': {'unit': K_UNIT, 'rid': K_POS, 'connection': K_PAIR,
             'stream': K_POS, 'wire': K_WIRE},
    'store': {'unit': K_UNIT, 'rid': K_POS, 'file': K_PAIR},
    'load': {'unit': K_UNIT, 'rid': K_POS, 'file': K_PAIR},
    'unlink': {'file': K_PAIR},
    'inspect': {},
}
SCHEMA_SIZE = {op: len(fields) + 1 for op, fields in SCHEMA.items()}


class Invalid(Exception):
